answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake of quartz-backed credit before it may harvest from the shared orchard of tasks, so one operator running a thousand fake identities to tend the communal garden must fund a thousand deposits at once. If any identity is caught attesting falsely, its stake is slashed and redistributed to honest peers, turning a cheap identity flood into a capital-intensive gamble where the attacker's own money pays the defenders.
